headline: A 2015 executive order changed an older order to create awards honoring students with special ability in career and technical education.
what_it_does: This order amends Executive Order 11155, an older order about student awards. Based on its title, it adds awards that recognize students who show special skill in career and technical education, such as job-focused or trade training programs. No summary was provided, so details like how many awards there are or how winners are picked are not covered here.

who_it_affects.group: High school students in career and technical education programs
who_it_affects.how: They may become eligible for a national award recognizing special skill in their field.

when_it_takes_effect: Likely upon signing on June 22, 2015 (not stated in the material provided).
